title: Chapter 411: The End Of The Wu Family
content:
Chapter 411: The End Of The Wu Family

Call the ancestor!

The Wu family actually wants to call their ancestors.

For a moment, everyone present changed their faces.

The ancestor of the Wu family, Wu Shang!

That legendary figure, once the leader of the human race, led the human race to develop vigorously. Later, he rushed back to the Chaos Realm when the human race was in crisis, turned the tide, and assisted the first palace master to create the Human Emperor Hall, and then served as the second-generation palace master.

He can write a legendary story throughout his life.

Such a great person is going to witness his respect again today?

As a terrifying aura rose deep in the Wu family.

The entire martial arts family seemed to have been suspended from time, and they were completely in a ghostly silence.

Everyone stopped their movements and looked in that direction, not daring to show their vigor.

Wu Shang, he is both the master of the Human Emperor Palace and the ancestor of the Wu family. Who knows who this existence will favor?

The same is true for Wu Yutian, the head of the Wu family. He was extremely nervous at this moment.

He had no other way.

Wu Hui didn't give him any chance at all. Even the moment he learned that the first palace master was back, Wu Hui led people to surround the entire Wu family.

He bet that he did not dare to rebel openly.

Now, he can only rely on the love of his ancestors.

Buzz —

Above the Wu family, in the void, a figure slowly emerged, from blur to clear.

At first, his eyes were still a little cloudy, but as he closed his eyes lightly and opened them again, a sharp edge flashed through his eyes.

The ancestor of the Wu family, the second-generation hall master of the Human Emperor Hall, and the Wu Shang!

"I didn't expect that the backhand I left would be triggered so quickly."

Wu Shang spoke gently, and could not tell whether it was joy or sorrow.

And at this moment, a figure suddenly rushed to his side, crawling on the ground, and his voice choked.

"My ancestor, please make the decision for our Wu family!!"

Wu Yutian was crying and looked extremely embarrassed.

Seeing this, the Wu family around them also reacted one after another and knelt down at Wu Shang, crying in tears, as if they had suffered some great grievance.

When everyone in the Human Emperor Palace saw this, they were all despised and showed disdain, but they couldn't help but feel a little worried.

What if the Wu Shang Lord is really soft-hearted and stands on the side of the Wu family?

At this time, a man who looked like a young man in the distance smiled at Wushang, "Master, I haven't seen you for many years, so I'm fine."

Wu Shang's eyes scandals the audience and finally stops at Wu Hui.

After watching for a long time, Wu Shang sighed slightly, "You have grown a lot."

"You taught them well."

"Haha, it's not disappointing me."

Wu Shang also chuckled.

This made Wu Yutian feel extremely uneasy. He couldn't help but speak to Wu Shang: "My ancestor, I,"

"Shut up, I know everything."

"ah?"

At this moment, Wu Yutian was completely panicked.

However, the family that Wu Shang looked at him and trained was full of disappointment.

His original intention was to make the Imperial Palace continue to grow by relying on the power of the Wu family. After all, although the Human Emperor Palace is orthodox, its establishment time is still too short, and it is not as good as the Wu family with a long history.

But he still underestimated the greed of his family and wanted to annex the Human Emperor Palace or even replace him.

This is a big taboo.

At this moment, he couldn't help but think of what Lu Xue said to him before leaving.

"Mr. Lord, are you leaving now?"

In the empty Human Emperor Hall, Wu Shang followed Lu Xue and couldn't help asking.

He felt that Lu Xue had not been in office for long.

Lu Xue walked outside the hall, looked at the Renhuang City that was being built in front of her, and chuckled, "Now the Renhuang Palace no longer needs me. Compared to me, the Renhuang Palace needs someone like you who can take on great responsibilities. ”

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Wu Shang knew that Lu Xue had decided to leave. After a moment of silence, he respectfully bowed to Lu Xue.

"Martial shanghai will never let down the palace master's entrusted."

Lu Xue slowly turned around, looked at Wu Shang, and said, "Of the three masters of the human race, you are the only one who owns your own family, which is why I asked you to stay."

An Chang was gone, and Huo Xingzhi also left.

Now the only three human heroes are left is Wu Shang.

"In recent years, the human race has been weak, and the powerful Wu family has made great contributions to leading the human race to resist. When you become the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, the Wu family will definitely become stronger at that time."

"Have you ever thought about it, after you leave?"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Wu Shang's expression changed slightly. According to Lu Xue's words, after he left, no one in the Wu family would be able to restrain him, and even the whole family would be the dominant one, even,

Wu Shang didn't dare to think about it. Could it be that he was going to destroy his relatives for justice now?

Seeing the ruthlessness revealed in Wu Shang's eyes, Lu Xue smiled.

"This is just a guess about the future. Who can tell the future exactly what happened?"

"However, you should pay attention."

Upon hearing this, Wu Shang breathed a sigh of relief, clasped his fists and said, "Wu Shang remembers it."

Until later, Wu Shang took office as the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace. As Lu Xue said, his Wu family became more and more powerful under his influence, and even became faintly comparable to the Human Emperor Palace.

This made him very worried.

Once the Wu family leaves, if they have two hearts, the human race will definitely fall into a disaster.

But he must leave, and he cannot stay in the Chaos Realm all the time.

To destroy relatives for justice?

In the end, Wu Shang did not make up his mind after all.

"I'll leave it to you, the Human Emperor Palace."

Looking at the boy in front of him, Wu Shang patted him on the shoulder and pressed the heavy responsibility of the Human Emperor Palace on the boy.

There was no trace of turmoil in the boy's eyes about this.

"Don't worry, Master, my disciple will not let you down."

Wu Hui smiled, remained silent for a moment, and suddenly asked, "Hua'er, how will you treat the Wu family after I leave?"

Although Wu Hui's surname is Wu, it actually has nothing to do with the Wu family.

He was trained by Wushang himself.

Wu Hui said sincerely: "The Wu family is your family. I treat the Wu family naturally as if I treat you."

Wu Shang hesitated for a moment, then said, "What if the Wu family has any evil intentions?"

Wu Hui smiled, "Master, no, the Wu family is your family, and you will never have any ill intentions."

Hearing such an answer, Wu Shang laughed.

"You boy."

How come I don’t understand my apprentice?

He knew that Wu Hui didn't want to make himself sad.

Unexpectedly, my soft heart even made my disciple laugh at me.

However, he was relieved.

Whatever the Wu family in the future depends on the Wu family's own luck.

But now it seems that the Wu family is still in such a situation after all, just as the first palace master said back then.

Fortunately, my apprentice did not disappoint me.

All situations have been stabilized.

Next, what should the Wu family do about it.

Wu Shang looked at his apprentice again, the current contemporary master of the Human Emperor Hall, Wu Hui.
